data.summary: Two actionable commitments were extracted from this interview transcript. Austin (the interviewer) committed to submitting his feedback and working with William on next steps, with a rough timeline of the following week for Rainie to hear back. The transcript is primarily a job interview conversation with minimal formal commitment language; most content consists of status sharing, opinions, and hypothetical discussions rather than actionable assignments.
